world-bank.name: World Bank — World Development Indicators
world-bank.attribution: World Bank, World Development Indicators. Individual indicators may identify additional data providers or restrictions in their metadata.

wid.name: World Inequality Database
wid.attribution: World Inequality Database. Values are estimates assembled from national accounts, surveys, tax data, wealth rankings, and other country-specific sources.

census-idb.name: U.S. Census Bureau International Database
census-idb.attribution: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.

oecd-eo107.name: OECD Economic Outlook 107 — historical pandemic snapshot
oecd-eo107.attribution: OECD Economic Outlook 107. The retained observations cover 2020-Q2 and 2021-Q4 and are presented only as historical pandemic context.

top1_wealth.label: Top 1% wealth share
top1_wealth.definition: The estimated share of personal net wealth owned by the richest 1% of individuals in the selected country.
top1_wealth.caveat: WID estimates reconcile multiple sources. Comparability and source quality vary by country.

top10_wealth.label: Top 10% wealth share
top10_wealth.definition: The estimated share of personal net wealth owned by the richest 10% of individuals in the selected country.
top10_wealth.caveat: WID estimates reconcile multiple sources. Comparability and source quality vary by country.

top1_income.label: Top 1% pre-tax income share
top1_income.definition: The estimated share of pre-tax national income received by the highest-income 1% of individuals.
top1_income.caveat: This measures pre-tax national income, not disposable household income.

top10_income.label: Top 10% pre-tax income share
top10_income.definition: The estimated share of pre-tax national income received by the highest-income 10% of individuals.
top10_income.caveat: This measures pre-tax national income, not disposable household income.

bottom50_income.label: Bottom 50% pre-tax income share
bottom50_income.definition: The estimated share of pre-tax national income received by the lower-income half of individuals.
bottom50_income.caveat: This measures pre-tax national income, not disposable household income.

gdp_per_capita_ppp.label: GDP per person, PPP
gdp_per_capita_ppp.definition: Annual economic output per resident, adjusted for national price levels and expressed in current international dollars.
gdp_per_capita_ppp.caveat: GDP per person is not household income or personal wealth.

consumption_per_capita.label: Household consumption per person
consumption_per_capita.definition: Household final consumption expenditure per person, expressed in constant 2015 US dollars.
consumption_per_capita.caveat: The constant-dollar series is suitable for change over time, but not for direct division by current international-dollar GDP.

population.label: Population
population.definition: The World Bank estimate of the total resident population.
population.caveat: Reference dates and estimation practices can differ across countries.

life_expectancy.label: Life expectancy at birth
life_expectancy.definition: Expected years of life at birth if the mortality rates observed in that year continued.
life_expectancy.caveat: This is a period life-expectancy measure, not a forecast for a person already alive.

age65_share.label: Population age 65 and older
age65_share.definition: The share of the modeled population age 65 or older after summing single-year age counts.
age65_share.caveat: IDB values are estimates and projections, not a single synchronized global census.
